standard.text: A test fails when it is over 104 MPN per 100 mL (single sample); far over means above 312.

levels_note: chance_min is included in the level and chance_max is not (except 1.0). tests, fail_share and far_over_share come from the 2022-2026 record, each year predicted from a fit on the other years; they are not a promise.
caveats: It is not an official advisory.
None of the levels means the water is safe.
It estimates the chance that a county test fails; it does not predict illness.
